edges: Mullah Mohammed Omar is the leader of the Taliban.
Sayyed Muhammad Akbar Agha commented on the rumors about Mullah Mohammed Omar's status.
Rahimullah Yusufzai noted Mullah Mohammed Omar's lack of public appearances and media engagement.
An assembly of Afghans swore allegiance to Mullah Mohammed Omar during this meeting.
Mullah Mohammed Omar's preferred weapon of choice was the RPG-7.
Mullah Mohammed Omar disappeared after the U.S.-led bombing campaign routed the Taliban from Kabul.
Mullah Mohammed Omar continues to oversee the Taliban leadership council and military commanders.
